purpose: Append-only diagnostic comparison of frozen Draft-Day class expectations to immutable Outcome class snapshots.
scoreDelta: outcomeScore - draftDayOverallScore; continuous and authoritative within the comparison layer.
letterMovement: Preserve exact Draft-Day and Outcome letters plus movement; do not use threshold crossing as the primary accuracy metric.
rankMovement: Ordinal within-season owner/class rank, stable ownerId tie-break; descriptive secondary context only.
confidence: Minimum of Draft-Day confidence, Outcome confidence, and maturity ceiling; 2025 is capped at LIMITED.

outlookReadiness.immediateImpact: NOT_READY; stored forecast field is not consistently populated and no thresholds are approved.
outlookReadiness.longTermUpside: NOT_READY; 2025 is excluded and no structured forecast field is consistently available.
outlookReadiness.trajectory: NOT_READY; preserve prose, do not apply arbitrary NLP scoring.

playerLevelRecommendation: Do not publish player-level accuracy in V1; Market Value is cost context, not a player projection.
ownerClassRecommendation: Use owner/class comparisons as the primary V1 unit; preserve player outcomes as explanatory evidence.

approval.futureChangeRule: Threshold or rule changes require forecast-vs-reality-v1.1 or v2 with explicit supersession; v1 methodology and snapshots are never rewritten.
